vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: furry-art-skill
Version: 1.6.3

The skill is a legitimate tool for generating AI art via the Neta AI API (api.talesofai.com). The core logic in `furryart.js` correctly implements job submission and polling for image results using the provided API token, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill appears to do what it claims (generate images via Neta/TalesOfAI) but the package/registry metadata omits the required API token and the included JS sends that token to api.talesofai.com — the metadata mismatch and lack of provenance are concerning.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, SKILL.md, README.md, and furryart.js all align: the script submits prompts to the Neta/TalesOfAI image API and returns an image URL. That capability is coherent with the stated purpose. Note: README explains api.talesofai.com is used as the Neta backend.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs providing a NETA_TOKEN and running the bundled furryart.js. The instructions and runtime behavior are narrowly scoped to calling the image API and polling for results; the script does not read other files or env vars.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or remote downloads; the skill is distributed as source files (furryart.js, SKILL.md, README). Nothing is fetched or extracted at install time, lowering install risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script requires a NETA_TOKEN (used as x-token in HTTP requests) which is appropriate for an API-backed image generator. However, registry metadata in the provided manifest earlier lists no required env vars while package.json (clawhub.env) and SKILL.md do declare NETA_TOKEN as required. This mismatch between registry metadata and the files is an incoherence to resolve before trusting the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no code attempts to modify other skills or system configuration. The skill runs on demand and does not request persistent elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill's code matches its description and will send whatever NETA_TOKEN you provide to api.talesofai.com to generate images. Two things to consider before installing: (1) the registry metadata you were shown lists no required env vars, but package.json, README, and SKILL.md — and the script itself (furryart.js) — require NETA_TOKEN. Ask the publisher to correct the registry manifest or explain the discrepancy. (2) Only supply a token you trust to be used with this service — if possible use a limited or throwaway API token to test. Review and confirm you are comfortable with api.talesofai.com as the endpoint (the README claims it is the Neta backend). If you need stronger assurance, run the script locally from the source, inspect network traffic, or request provenance/maintainer info (homepage, repo, or publisher) before granting access to a high-value token.
